public class Text_Document_Analysis {

    public static void main(String[] args) {

        int bracketSegments = countNonEmptySegments(bracketProcessed);

    }

    private static String processUnderscore(String input, int n) {
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
        int i = 0;
        while (i < n) {
            if (input.charAt(i) == '(') {
                i++;
                while (i < n && input.charAt(i) != ')') {
                    i++;

                if (i < n) i++;
                result.append('_');
                result.append('_');
            } else {

            }
        }
        result.append('_');
        return result.toString();
    }

    private static String processBracket(String input, int n) {
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
        int i = 0;
        while (i < n) {
            if (input.charAt(i) == '(') {
                i++;
                while (i < n && input.charAt(i) != ')') {
                    result.append(input.charAt(i));
                    i++;
                }
                if (i < n) i++;
                result.append('_');
            } else {
                i++;

        }
        result.append('_');

    private static int calculateLongestSequence(String s) {
        int max = 0, cur = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            if (s.charAt(i) == '_') {
                max = Math.max(max, cur);
                cur = 0;
            } else {
                cur++;

        }
        return Math.max(max, cur);

    private static int countNonEmptySegments(String s) {
        int count = 0;
        for (String segment : s.split("_", -1)) {
            if (!segment.isEmpty()) count++;
        }
        return count;
    }

import java.util.Scanner;

public class Text_Document_Analysis {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = Integer.parseInt(sc.nextLine().trim());
        String s = sc.nextLine().trim();
        String us = buildUnderscoreString(s, n);
        String bc = buildBracketString(s, n);

        int longest = findLongestConsecutiveNonUnderscore(us);
        int groups = countNonEmptyGroups(bc);

        System.out.println(longest + " " + groups);
    }

    private static String buildUnderscoreString(String s, int n) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("_");
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char ch = s.charAt(i);
            if (ch == '(') {
                sb.append('_');
                i++;
                while (i < n && s.charAt(i) != ')') i++;
            } else {
                sb.append(ch);
            }
        }
        sb.append('_');
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private static String buildBracketString(String s, int n) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("_");
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char ch = s.charAt(i);
            if (ch == '(') {
                i++;
                while (i < n && s.charAt(i) != ')') {
                    sb.append(s.charAt(i));
                    i++;
                }
                sb.append('_');
            } else {
                i++;
            }
        }
        sb.append('_');
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private static int findLongestConsecutiveNonUnderscore(String s) {
        int maxRun = 0, currentRun = 0;
        for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
            if (c == '_') {
                if (currentRun > maxRun) maxRun = currentRun;
                currentRun = 0;
            } else {
                currentRun++;
            }
        }
        if (currentRun > maxRun) maxRun = currentRun;
        return maxRun;
    }

    private static int countNonEmptyGroups(String s) {
        int count = 0;
        int lastNonUnderscoreIndex = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            if (s.charAt(i) != '_') {
                lastNonUnderscoreIndex = i;
            } else if (lastNonUnderscoreIndex >= 0) {
                count++;
                lastNonUnderscoreIndex = -1;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }
}
